reason: Within-subject LOEO can measure a seen participant in another recorded environment. However, environment codes repeat across participants without a physical installation ID proving equal codes denote the same room. Participant holdout therefore also holds out that participant's three compound domains.
collection_needed: Factorial data: multiple participants in the same instrumented installations and the same participants across multiple installations, with installation/geometry IDs.
claim_limit: Three held-out participants are diagnostic folds, not a population-level human generalization estimate. Report every fold and avoid a broad generalization claim.
